co-equal facet

  • CURIE: gmeow:coequalFacet
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/coequalFacet
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/kernel

Marks a property as one co-equal identity-facet axis among peers (CONSTITUTION P9). Every property annotated coequalFacet true is held orthogonal to every other by the generated reasoning lint: its range is its own (distinct from every other axis), no rdfs:subPropertyOf or owl:equivalentProperty bridge may connect two axes, none may be owl:FunctionalProperty (a single locked value invites exactly the owl:sameAs collapse Principle 5 forbids), and all axis ranges must be jointly declared owl:AllDisjointClasses. A new annotated axis receives Principle 9 enforcement by construction.

Structure

Property shape: annotation property

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:coequalFacet when the definition matches the source fact. Prefer a narrower GMEOW term when one exists, and keep projection concerns in the mapping layer.
